entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Nationalist Movement and Independence, a transformative movement in Sri Lanka (1900–1948). Emerged from British and Conquest of Kandy and Plantation Economy. Catalyzed Ceylon becomes the first Asian colony to gain universal suffrage and Ceylon gains independence from Britain as a Dominion.
